ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportCechy' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportCechy;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportCechy] @rowVersion bigint AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
declare @MaxInt int = 2147483647 --Max Int SELECT isnull((select max(CCK_CzasModyfikacji) from cdn.CechyKlasy where CCK_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion),@rowVersion) AS [@RowVersion] ,( select * from( select 0 as [@Id], '' as [@Name], -- as [@DirectoryID], NULL 10 as [@ValueType] where @rowVersion = 0 -- Pusta cecha przy pierwszej synchronizacji
union all
select cck_Gidnumer as [@Id], RTRIM(CCK_Nazwa) as [@Name], -- as [@DirectoryID], NULL 10 as [@ValueType] from cdn.CechyKlasy where CCK_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion
union all
select @MaxInt as [@Id], 'data ważności' as [@Name], -- as [@DirectoryID], NULL 15 as [@ValueType]) a
for xml path('Feature'), type) for xml path('Features') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportCechy TO CDNRaport
